attempts.summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as a persistent, confined Bash worker. It runs as locked UID/GID 992 (inventorysvc), uses the root-owned /srv/inventory-worker chroot, and can write only /var/lib/inventory. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, SELinux enforcement, SSH access, and existing services were preserved. Crash recovery and full reboot persistence were verified.
